phases.name: hold (planche)
phases.orientation: horizontal face-down, head pointing forward (beyond the hands)
phases.arms: straight, supporting the weight, hands on the floor under the front part of the torso (around chest/hips line), shoulders leaned forward of the hands
phases.legs: together, straight, horizontal, in line with the torso

variants: swallow form: same horizontal body, held lower (body almost at hand height), hands further back beside the hips with arms wider
mustShow: whole body horizontal and straight, feet off the floor
only the hands touch the floor, arms straight
legs together (straddled legs is a different, lower element)
mfx_planche_hold.notes: Shoulders well forward of the hands is what keeps the body level. Not to be confused with the straddled planche (legs apart) or a lever on bent arms.

mfx_salto_bwd_stretched_full_twist.travel: backward (gymnast faces away from travel); somersault rotation backward = clockwise in a side view with travel to the right; 1/1 twist (360 deg) about the long axis during the flight, essentially completed by the time the body passes the inverted position and finished before landing

phases.name: take-off
phases.orientation: upright, slightly leaning back toward travel
phases.arms: straight overhead

phases.name: rise / twist starts
phases.orientation: diagonal, head toward direction of travel and up
phases.arms: pulling in toward the chest / one arm across to initiate twist

phases.name: peak (inverted, twisting)
phases.orientation: inverted, head down
phases.arms: close to the body (wrapped to chest or along body) for the twist

phases.name: descent (twist finished)
phases.orientation: diagonal, feet leading down toward the landing
phases.arms: opening sideways / forward

phases.name: landing
phases.orientation: upright
phases.arms: straight, raised forward-up / overhead

mustShow: body straight (no tuck, no pike) through the whole salto
one full backward rotation combined with one full twist
lands on both feet facing the same way as at take-off
mfx_salto_bwd_stretched_full_twist.notes: Usually done out of a round-off (and often a flic-flac). Because rotation and twist are both 360 deg, the gymnast lands facing the same direction as at take-off, travel continues backward. A twist arrow around the long axis is the cue that distinguishes it from a plain layout.

mrg_swallow.apparatus: one ring with its strap (the other is hidden behind in a side view); strap vertical

phases.name: hold (support scale at ring height)
phases.orientation: horizontal face-down, head pointing forward
phases.arms: straight, supporting the weight, pressed down and slightly out to the sides so the hands are level with the hips
phases.where: body at the same height as the rings (rings beside the hips)

mustShow: body horizontal and straight AT ring height (not above the rings like a planche)
arms straight, rings at hip level
straps vertical / still
mrg_swallow.notes: Also called maltese cross on rings. Difference from the planche (II.9): in the planche the body is above the rings with hands under the shoulders; in the swallow the body is lowered so its line passes through the rings.

mrg_cross_any_or_v_cross.apparatus: both rings with both straps, straps vertical

phases.name: hold (cross)
phases.orientation: upright, head up
phases.arms: straight, horizontal, out to the sides, supporting the weight
phases.where: rings at shoulder height, one at each hand, body centred between the straps

variants: L-cross: same arms, legs raised forward horizontal (L-sit shape), better seen from the side or 3/4
V-cross: same arms, hips piked so the legs point up above horizontal (V-sit shape)
mustShow: arms straight and horizontal, in line with the shoulders
body vertical between the two rings
rings at shoulder level (not below)
mrg_cross_any_or_v_cross.notes: Element name covers any cross (normal, L, V). The plain cross is the clearest single image; the inverted cross is a separate element (II.4).

mpb_sp_l_sit_hold.apparatus: parallel bars, rails seen from the side (one rail in front of the other)

phases.name: hold (L-sit)
phases.orientation: upright torso, head up
phases.arms: straight, vertical, supporting the weight, hands on the rails beside the hips
phases.legs: together, straight, horizontal, pointing forward along the rails
phases.where: above the rails, hips between/just above the rails

mustShow: legs horizontal (90 deg hip angle), together and straight
arms straight in support
only the hands touch the bars
mpb_sp_l_sit_hold.notes: Legs below horizontal is an execution fault; legs above horizontal toward V is a different element.

mhb_fl_tkatchev_straddle.apparatus: high bar end-on with its uprights
mhb_fl_tkatchev_straddle.travel: the gymnast swings forward under the bar, releases on the upswing and flies backward over the bar (opposite to the swing direction), regrasping on the same side the swing started from; no twist (1/2 twist is a variant)

phases.name: forward swing (tap)
phases.bodyShape: stretched, passing slight arch to hollow
phases.orientation: inverted-to-hanging, passing under the bar
phases.arms: straight overhead, hands on bar

phases.name: release
phases.orientation: diagonal, legs higher than head, rising on the far side of the bar
phases.arms: straight, just leaving the bar
phases.where: in front of and above bar level

phases.name: over the bar
phases.orientation: upright torso above the bar, facing the bar, head up
phases.arms: straight, reaching forward-down toward the bar
phases.legs: straddled wide, roughly horizontal, pointing forward over the bar

phases.name: regrasp / hang
phases.orientation: hanging, head up toward the bar
phases.arms: straight overhead, hands on bar

mustShow: body passes above the bar in a straddle-pike, legs wide
release on the forward swing and flight backward over the bar
regrasp to hang
mhb_fl_tkatchev_straddle.notes: Counter-rotating release: the flight rotation is opposite to the swing. Piked legs-together (Tv) and straight body (Tkatchev straight) are separate elements, so legs must be clearly straddled.

mph_circle_or_flair_side_support.view: front (looking at the long side of the horse)
mph_circle_or_flair_side_support.apparatus: pommel horse body with both pommels; hands on the pommels
mph_circle_or_flair_side_support.travel: continuous circular swing of the legs and hips around the hands in a near-horizontal plane, 360 deg per circle; direction either way (most often counter-clockwise seen from above); one hand lifts at a time to let the legs pass

phases.name: front support
phases.orientation: body extended toward the viewer side, front of body facing the horse
phases.arms: straight, both hands on the pommels
phases.where: legs on the near side of the horse

phases.name: side passage
phases.orientation: horizontal face-up/face-down sweeping over one end, head pointing to the opposite side
phases.arms: one straight supporting arm, other hand lifted
phases.legs: together, straight, horizontal over the horse

phases.name: rear support
phases.orientation: back to the horse, body extended to the far side
phases.arms: straight, both hands on pommels
phases.where: legs on the far side of the horse

variants: flair: same circle with legs straddled wide (a flair variant may rise toward handstand, e.g. Thomas flair)
circle outside or between the pommels is a separate element (II.2)
mustShow: only the hands touch the horse, legs never touch it
body extended and near horizontal through the circle (legs together = circle, wide straddle = flair)
full 360 deg path of the legs around the hands
mph_circle_or_flair_side_support.notes: Side support = body crosswise to the horse's long axis. Hips must stay open (no pike) during the circle.

fx_round_off.travel: forward entry; half turn (180 deg) about the long axis during the hand support (1/4 on the first hand, 1/4 after the handstand), so the gymnast lands facing back toward where she came from

phases.name: lunge / reach
phases.orientation: upright leaning forward, head toward travel
phases.arms: straight overhead
phases.legs: front leg bent in lunge, rear leg straight behind

phases.name: hand placement
phases.orientation: diagonal, head down toward the floor
phases.arms: straight, first hand then second hand on the floor, body turning 1/4
phases.legs: split front/back, rear leg swinging up

phases.name: handstand, legs join
phases.orientation: inverted, head down
phases.arms: straight, supporting the weight

phases.name: snap-down / short flight
phases.bodyShape: slightly hollow / piked at the hips
phases.orientation: diagonal, feet leading down, head following
phases.arms: straight, pushing off and lifting from the floor

phases.name: landing
phases.orientation: upright
phases.arms: straight overhead
phases.legs: together, both feet land at the same time
phases.where: floor, facing opposite to the entry direction

mustShow: legs join together at or just after the handstand
half turn: lands on both feet at once facing back toward the start
push from the hands into a short flight before the feet land
fx_round_off.notes: Not a cartwheel: a cartwheel lands one foot after the other facing sideways. The round-off's landing faces backward so it can feed a backward element.

bb_split_leap_fwd.apparatus: balance beam with its legs/support, mat under it optional
bb_split_leap_fwd.travel: forward along the beam; no turn

phases.name: approach steps
phases.orientation: upright, head toward travel
phases.arms: low/forward, swinging

phases.name: take-off
phases.orientation: upright
phases.arms: swinging forward-up
phases.legs: push from one leg, lead leg swinging forward straight

phases.name: flight (split)
phases.orientation: upright, head up and forward
phases.arms: straight, raised sideways-up (high diagonal) or one forward, one sideways
phases.legs: split front/back, both straight, 180 deg separation, roughly horizontal

phases.name: landing
phases.orientation: upright
phases.arms: sideways/forward-up for balance
phases.legs: land on the front (lead) leg, rear leg extended back then lowered
phases.where: on beam, further along than take-off

mustShow: 180 deg front/back split in the air with both legs straight
take-off from one foot and landing on the other (lead) foot
travel along the beam, torso upright
bb_split_leap_fwd.notes: Leap = one-foot take-off; the split jump (2.202) takes off from both feet. Legs split in the direction of the beam (not straddle).

vt_ro_bwd_layout.apparatus: runway end, springboard, vault table, landing mat
vt_ro_bwd_layout.travel: run forward toward the table; round-off before the board turns the gymnast so she reaches the board backward; flic-flac (back handspring) onto the table; one stretched salto backward off the table with no twist; lands facing the table

phases.name: round-off on runway
phases.orientation: inverted, head down
phases.arms: straight, hands on the mat before the board

phases.name: board contact
phases.orientation: upright, back to the table
phases.arms: straight, swinging back-up overhead

phases.name: first flight / table contact (flic-flac)
phases.orientation: inverted, head down toward the table, back leading
phases.arms: straight overhead, hands on the table

phases.name: second flight (layout salto)
phases.orientation: rotating backward; passes inverted then descends feet first
phases.arms: straight, close to the body or overhead

phases.name: landing
phases.orientation: upright, facing back toward the table
phases.arms: straight forward

mustShow: round-off before the springboard and backward hand contact on the table
straight body during the salto off the table (not tucked or piked)
no twist: lands facing the table
vt_ro_bwd_layout.notes: Yurchenko family. 1st flight: backward, hands to table. 2nd flight: one backward salto stretched; adding a twist makes it a different vault (4.31+).
